note: The one list both provider rate-limit classifiers are pinned to: is_provider_rate_limited_failure in packages/runtime-controller/src/agent.rs, which labels a failed run in the agent's history, and the provider_rate_limited kind of classifyRunFailureText in packages/frontend/src/conversations/runFailurePresentation.ts, which picks the Studio's failure card. A pattern changed on one side and not the other fails a test on both. `providerRateLimited` is whether the text is that kind.
